notes: Prompt reads "in 1/2 hours" — should be "1/2 hour" or "half an hour". Mixed number "2 1/2" is plain inline text and can be misread as 21/2 or 2 x 1/2; render it as a proper mixed fraction.

MC distractors are 149, 147 and 1 — the correct 150 is the only round number, so it can be picked without doing the scaling. Use error-based distractors (e.g. 50/3, 53) instead of +/-1 noise.

Concept is titled "Describe length/weight" (grade 0) but this item asks about temperature, and the choices include "capacity" — that word plus "attribute" in the prompt is above a kindergarten reading level.
